docs: `#[program]` marks this module as the list of instructions the program accepts.

instructions.name: increment
docs: Add one to the caller's Counter (hello-world).

accounts.name: authority
docs: The wallet that owns the counter.

accounts.name: counter
docs: The caller's Counter. `seeds` + `bump = counter.bump` re-derive the PDA with the stored bump,
and `has_one = authority` checks `counter.authority == authority`, so nobody else's wallet

accounts.name: authority
docs: The wallet creating the counter. It signs the transaction and pays the rent.

accounts.name: counter
docs: The new Counter. Its address is a PDA derived from `["counter", authority]`, so each wallet
has exactly one and anyone can find it. `init` fails if it already exists.

accounts.name: system_program
docs: Needed because creating an account is done by the built-in System Program.

errors.name: CounterOverflow
errors.msg: The counter cannot go any higher

types.name: Counter
docs: A tiny account that stores who owns it and a number they can increase.
`#[account]` tells Anchor this struct is stored on chain (it handles saving and loading).
`#[derive(InitSpace)]` makes Anchor work out how many bytes the struct needs (`Counter::INIT_SPACE`).

fields.name: authority
docs: The wallet that created this counter and is allowed to increase it.

fields.name: count
docs: How many times `increment` has been called. Starts at 0.

fields.name: bump
docs: The PDA bump, stored so later instructions reuse it instead of searching again.

constants.name: COUNTER_SEED
docs: Seed for the Phase 0 hello-world Counter PDA: `["counter", authority]`.
`#[constant]` also exports the value into the IDL, so the app can read the same seed.
